meta.note: Curated, sourced records of worldwide security & privacy compliance frameworks. Every record cites URLs actually referenced during collection. Normalized claims authored here are CC0-1.0; cited sources retain their own rights.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
frameworks.scope: Information security management systems (ISMS). International standard; certification via accredited bodies.
frameworks.license: Standard sold by ISO; summaries fair use

frameworks.name: SOC 2 (Type I / Type II)
frameworks.scope: Service organization controls over security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity and privacy. Audited by CPA firms (AICPA Trust Services Criteria).
frameworks.license: Public criteria description; report access restricted

frameworks.name: PCI DSS 4.0
frameworks.scope: Cardholder data environment security, mandated by card brands via acquiring contracts. 4.0.1 published 2024-06; future-dated requirements enforce from 2025-03.

frameworks.name: GDPR (EU 2016/679)
frameworks.scope: EU/EEA personal-data processing; fines up to 4% of global turnover. Applies extraterritorially to controllers/processors offering services into the EU.

frameworks.name: CCPA / CPRA (Cal. Civ. Code 1798)
frameworks.scope: California consumer privacy rights; thresholds by revenue or data volume. Model for 20+ US state privacy laws.

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
frameworks.scope: Govern-Identify-Protect-Detect-Respond-Recover profile for any organization size/sector. Not certifiable directly; used as an organizing layer.

frameworks.name: CIS Controls v8.1
frameworks.scope: 18 controls, Implementation Group 1-3 prioritization. Basis for many product scorecards and Mappings.

frameworks.name: FedRAMP (NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 baseline)
frameworks.scope: US federal cloud service authorization (Low/Moderate/High, FIPS 199). Rev.5 baselines; FIPS 200/199. Authorization via JAB or agency ATO.

frameworks.name: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR 164 Subpart C)
frameworks.scope: Safeguards for electronic protected health information (ePHI) by covered entities and business associates.

frameworks.name: DORA (EU 2022/2554)
frameworks.scope: EU digital operational resilience for financial entities; ICT third-party risk, resilience testing, applies from 2025-01-17.

frameworks.name: EU Cyber Resilience Act (EU 2024/2847)
frameworks.scope: Products with digital elements sold in the EU: secure-by-design, vulnerability handling, CE marking; entered into force 2024-12, main obligations phase in 2027.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (privacy extension)
frameworks.scope: PIMS extension to ISO 27001 for PII controllers/processors; used to evidence GDPR accountability.
frameworks.license: Standard sold by ISO; summaries fair use

frameworks.name: CSA Cloud Controls Matrix v4
frameworks.scope: 197 controls mapped to ISO 27001/17, NIST, PCI; the CAIQ questionnaire underpins the STAR registry.

frameworks.name: APRA CPS 234
frameworks.scope: Australian information-security obligations for APRA-regulated entities and their service providers.

frameworks.name: 個人情報保護法 (APPI)
frameworks.scope: Japan personal-information protection; PPC rules and cross-border transfer conditions. 2022 amendment expanded breach reporting.

frameworks.name: UK GDPR + Data Protection Act 2018
frameworks.scope: UK retained GDPR with ICO enforcement; separate from EU GDPR post-Brexit, UK extension ratio in 2025.
